profiles.implementationBoundary: Dawnreach has a persistent prototype town using interim assemblies. Eight original Blender civic models are being authored; no final-town acceptance is implied.
profiles.visualSignature: A red-roofed river town climbs three irregular stone terraces to a timber-galleried court.
profiles.landscape: A wooded Carpathian ridge ends above a river bend. Exposed limestone anchors retaining walls; orchards and narrow fields soften the approach.
profiles.heroLandmark: Dawnreach High Court: a broad timber hall between unequal stone towers, with a sheltered public stair below. The hall roof, not an oversized spire, dominates.

composition.foreground: The river landing and outer gate frame the bottom corners; a cart track curves past clustered workshops.
composition.middle: Dense but permeable red-roofed lanes surround a triangular market and grain court. Purchased buildings occupy the near edge of the relevant district.
composition.background: The high court and crest eyrie rise above a wooded saddle. Distant ridges and river continuation remain real terrain.
composition.route: A bent processional lane connects water, market and high court through two visible stairs; side alleys serve housing.
composition.negativeSpace: Keep the market triangle and the long stair to the hall legible. Avoid an empty rectangular lawn.

profiles.visualSignature: An inhabited forest hollow arranged around open glades and enormous root buttresses, with low crescent roofs below an unbroken living canopy.
profiles.landscape: A damp wooded basin with a shallow stream, mossy outcrops and mature broadleaf trees. The town follows natural clearings rather than felling a square.
profiles.heroLandmark: The Oldgrowth Seat spans the roots of three ancient trees; its inhabited timber terraces have stairs, railings and visibly supported floors.

composition.foreground: A low root bridge and herb beds lead into the glade; fallen trunks and working gardens create scale.
composition.middle: Small clustered shelters sit around three distinct clearings, with the Measure Ring deliberately open and free of traffic.
composition.background: The Oldgrowth Seat frames a pale break in the canopy; the Wyrm Hollow disappears into a wooded ridge.
composition.route: A figure-eight footpath serves the stream crossing, nursery and communal ring without walking through the ritual space.
composition.negativeSpace: Preserve the central dance ring and the gaps beneath roots; foliage may frame but cannot conceal selectable roofs.

animatedLife: slow water and hanging seed gourds
a wingless Veilkin rehearsal with clear foot contact
wind passing through canopy at varied phases
controlled lantern insects away from labels
profiles.upgradeExample: A bower becomes a supported arcaded shelter; nursery beds expand along an existing root wall; a communal ring gains carved boundary stones while its floor stays open.

profiles.visualSignature: A sparse chain of mountain schools bridges separate crags around a great copper weather instrument; large sky gaps define the silhouette.
profiles.landscape: A high pass with cliffs, scree shelves, hanging cloud and a distant snow line. Architecture grips actual ledges with deep foundations.
profiles.heroLandmark: The Storm Dial, a low circular observatory crowned by a tilted copper ring and grounded stone counterweights, stands on the central crag.

composition.foreground: A steep arrival stair and sheltered pack yard establish the climb; ropes and low walls protect the exposed edge.
composition.middle: Compact slate-roofed schools occupy three ledges connected by visibly engineered timber-and-stone bridges.
composition.background: The Crown Aerie occupies a separate peak against open sky; a long mountain chain gives depth without filling every gap.
composition.route: A zigzag stair climbs to the school court, then divides into a weather terrace and a high aerie route.
composition.negativeSpace: Keep open sky between the main masses and a clear flying approach; never bridge every crag into a continuous wall.

animatedLife: weather vanes and weighted wind ropes
a distant creature landing after a readable approach
profiles.upgradeExample: The school adds a real instrument wing and storm shutters; a terrace gains a supported bridge and a second measuring station; new mass must not close the skyline gaps.

profiles.visualSignature: A dense stone city fills a narrow ravine beneath two unequal bell towers, with stacked galleries and a long reflecting canal.
profiles.landscape: An enclosed valley with black water, bare orchard slopes and layered limestone cliffs. Mist stays low enough to preserve door and bridge readability.
profiles.heroLandmark: The Court of Last Bells joins a tall narrow bell tower to a broad inhabited hall across a suspended covered gallery.

composition.foreground: A low canal quay and stone bridge frame the entrance; worn steps descend to water without blocking the main route.
composition.middle: Narrow courtyards and tall slate roofs stack along both banks. The Crimson Hall faces a quiet long square.
composition.background: The unequal bell towers and a terraced memorial garden close the ravine; only a thin band of sky remains.
composition.route: A canal-side route connects quay, hall and foundry; short stairs reach upper courts and crypt doors.
composition.negativeSpace: The reflecting canal and long hall square are the main open shapes; avoid scattering graves uniformly across the scene.

profiles.visualSignature: A low, spread-out alpine settlement circles a great hearth beneath broken stone teeth; long log roofs follow the bowl of the valley.
profiles.landscape: A cold mountain bowl with pine edges, snow remnants, streams and sheltered rock overhangs. Paths follow contour lines and animal trails.
profiles.heroLandmark: The Split-Hearth Hall is two offset longhouses joined around an open stone fire court, with a tall carved signal mast rather than a castle spire.

composition.foreground: Hunting racks, timber sledges and a stream crossing frame the approach, leaving a broad route for large animals.
composition.middle: Low houses form an incomplete ring around the pack hearth; kennels and a moon court sit on separate lateral terraces.
composition.background: The Ancient Winter Den opens beneath a rock shelf, with the split peaks behind it and no urban skyline.
composition.route: A broad crescent track links hunting yards, hearth and dens; narrow human shortcuts cross between terraces.
composition.negativeSpace: The open hearth court and large-animal paths remain broad; heavy creatures never squeeze through human doorways.

animatedLife: human and wolf patrols sharing routes
profiles.upgradeExample: The pack hall extends with a real second log bay; dens gain stone thresholds and shelter depth; a training court adds racks and a covered exercise edge.

profiles.visualSignature: A heavy terraced copper city steps into a mineral basin, with a broad horn-roofed palace above furnaces and cooling channels.
profiles.landscape: An ochre and charcoal escarpment cut by engineered terraces, ore yards and clear cooling water. The ground is mineral rather than a uniform lava field.
profiles.heroLandmark: The Horn Palace: massive stepped masonry with two swept copper roof ridges and a wide shaded giant-scale entrance.

composition.foreground: Ore carts, cooling troughs and a guarded bridge occupy the lower work terrace.
composition.middle: Furnace courts and workers shelters interlock in a dense industrial band, with tall chimneys grouped instead of evenly repeated.
composition.background: The palace spans the upper rim; the Deep Furnace opens into the cliff and throws restrained light from within.
composition.route: A broad haul road climbs two switchbacks from the ore yard to palace and deep furnace; narrower maintenance bridges cross water channels.
composition.negativeSpace: Keep a clear haul route and large creature assembly courts; fire and smoke cannot cover the production entrances.

animatedLife: furnace shutters opening on short cycles
profiles.upgradeExample: A furnace adds a real flue and cooling run; a copper range gains a reinforced gallery; palace expansions use heavy buttresses rather than floating ornament.

profiles.visualSignature: A horizontal town of reed roofs and narrow islands stretches across braided water around a low mirrored court.
profiles.landscape: A shallow delta with open channels, reed beds, muddy banks and distant flat water. Piles and pontoons visibly carry every building.
profiles.heroLandmark: The Mirror Court is a low crescent hall on two islands joined by an open water court, with a broad reed roof and reflective basin.

composition.foreground: Fishing boats, mooring piles and a plank landing establish scale; open water fills a major part of the frame.
composition.middle: Stilt houses form two staggered island bands joined by angled boardwalks. Working docks face different channels.
composition.background: The Mirror Court and a long channel lead toward reed islands and low distant woodland, preserving a flat horizon.
composition.route: A loop of boardwalks links the dry islands; boats follow separate channels with clear bridge headroom.
composition.negativeSpace: Water channels are the town squares. Do not fill them with decorative platforms or constant fog.

profiles.visualSignature: A dense bridge-and-market town converges on a tall guild counting house, with different roof bands marking nine incoming roads.
profiles.landscape: A broad river crossing where raised roads meet on firm terraces. Warehouses, hedged fields and caravan yards fill the edges.
profiles.heroLandmark: The Ninefold Exchange rises above a covered bridge: a narrow timber counting tower over a wide masonry guild hall and open loading arcade.

composition.foreground: A caravan yard, scales and a gatehouse frame the arrival road; the bridge crosses diagonally through the scene.
composition.middle: Dense workshops and market lanes fan around a central exchange square. Roof pitch and frontage width vary by district.
composition.background: The counting tower, a crane yard and the road forks lead toward farms and a distant wooded ridge.
composition.route: Three visible approach roads meet the exchange; back lanes serve goods so carts do not pass through every public stall.
composition.negativeSpace: Leave the exchange square and cart-turning courts usable. Density comes from roofs and working edges, not obstructed roads.

profiles.visualSignature: A subterranean town forms a crescent of occupied stone terraces around a daylight shaft, with low heavy lintels and a great suspended stone chime.
profiles.landscape: A cut mountain hall opens toward a real exterior gorge. Rock walls, descending galleries and an unseen deep shaft create depth without a flat cave backdrop.
profiles.heroLandmark: The Echo Seat is an inhabited stepped stone hall beneath a suspended lithic chime, carried by visible timber-and-iron engineering.

composition.foreground: A broad stone arrival bridge crosses the daylight shaft; lamps and worn stair edges define safe routes.
composition.middle: Dense low-roofed workshops and homes form a descending crescent around the shaft. Hoists occupy its far edge.
composition.background: The Echo Seat and Deepcoil Vault recede into separate side halls; warm task lights reveal their thresholds without illuminating the whole cavern uniformly.
composition.route: A broad ramp joins three working terraces; small stairs and lift platforms offer visible secondary circulation.
composition.negativeSpace: Keep the shaft void and main ramp legible. Dark areas must support depth without hiding building selection or route edges.
